name: Rizuhble's Fridge Tank Kelvin
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-6,400 (levels 1-12). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Arctic Beam T2, Frozen Shelter unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Torment Pulse. Ultimate (Frozen Shelter) is available from Extra Regen.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Frost Grenade (2 to 3).

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 8 to Ice Path's explode damage (0.80x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Torment Pulse completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 11 to 38 spirit power.

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healbane, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 17.6 per second to Arctic Beam's damage per second (0.98x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 6,400-20,800 (levels 12-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Frost Grenade T3, Arctic Beam T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Frost Grenade, damage) grows from 136 to 271. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Healbane.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healbane, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Healbane completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Healbane completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Healbane
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Arctic Beam: takes 18% off its 15s base cooldown. Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,800 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Imbued on Frost Grenade: widens its radius.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Arctic Beam: its duration-scaled parts (duration 5s, ice beam buildup proc duration 2s) get +22%. Takes spirit from 9,600 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Infuser
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 20,800-48,000 (levels 26-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Ice Path T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Frost Grenade, damage) grows from 271 to 434.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Frost Grenade (3 to 4). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 13,600 to 18,400 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 225s; 20% off is 45s per full rotation.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 20,000 to 24,800 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. | +30 spirit adds about 42 to Frost Grenade's damage (1.40x scaling).

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Frozen Shelter radius (10m), Arctic Beam path length (25m), Arctic Beam beam split (10m). Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Frozen Shelter duration (6.5s), Ice Path duration (8s), Arctic Beam duration (5s). Takes spirit from 27,200 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Healbane? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healing Booster.
sections.desc: Dying after Healbane? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healing Booster.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Geist, Vyper.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Ice Path (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: On the grenade. Sell Torment Pulse for this.

items.name: Scourge
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: Cast it on yourself before you walk in. Sell Bullet Resilience for this.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Arctic Beam: resets its 15s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Replaces Superior Duration: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On the beam. Sell Superior Duration for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..
